description: This file defines a React context for managing notes in a note-taking web application. It includes types, a reducer for handling note actions, context creation, and hooks for accessing notes state, as well as utility functions for local storage persistence and note creation.

methods.name: notesReducer
methods.description: reducer function handling note actions like load, add, update, delete, select, and setQuery.

methods.name: loadFromStorage
methods.description: loads notes from localStorage with validation.

methods.name: useNotes
methods.description: custom hook to access notes context, throws if used outside provider.

methods.name: NotesProvider
methods.description: React component that provides notes context to children, manages loading and saving notes.

methods.name: createNewNote
methods.description: utility function to create a new note with default values.
